_comment: Rarities. Key = last part of the item's tooltip style (telos:untiered/bloodshot -> bloodshot). label + color (#RRGGBB, item name colour): equipment scan. glyph = chat icon, icon = loot glyph in the dungeon lore / pouch icon (FAQ -> Loot Information, default font of the server pack), damageThreshold = % of the boss's damage needed for that loot. bag = loot bag totem (item model telos:mob/pouch/<bag>, custom model telemetric:bags/<bag>), sound = drop sound suffix (noise:player.bags.create_<sound>, default: the key). eventBags = bags that are no rarity (group = Lifetime Stats row, default event). companions = pet / mount rarities (name colour, counts). Rebuild JSON keeps every hand-written field.
